name: lmp-init-units-water-001
description: Pick the most appropriate LAMMPS `units` style for an all-atom water simulation with a TIP3P force field (masses in amu, distances in Å, time in fs).

examples.input:
# Initialization snippet
# Goal: simulate liquid water with TIP3P
atom_style full
read_data data.water_tip3p
pair_style lj/cut/coul/long 10.0
pair_coeff ...
mass 1 15.999
timestep 1.0
# which units? choose one word: real, metal, lj, si
